name: io.github.vince-gonzalez/authorecon
title: authorecon
description: Resolves a bibliography or a published record against Crossref, DataCite, OpenAlex, Europe PMC, PubMed, Zenodo and ORCID: which references actually exist, what has been retracted, what is stuck outside the indexes.

runtimeArguments.name: --from
runtimeArguments.description: The MCP server lives behind an optional dependency so the reconciliation tools stay entirely dependency-free for anyone who only wants the command line.

packageArguments.description: Starts the stdio server. The package's other entry points run the individual command-line tools.
